_comment: Machine-readable report layouts for the PX13 SA205H pen project, in the
spirit of envytools databases: the prose on the wiki's reference pages is
the authority; this file is the same information for tools. tools/wiki/
dissect.py reads it. Offsets count the Report ID as byte 0 and are
start-of-field + length; all integers little-endian unless noted.
Only offsets that a capture or the reference implementation confirmed are
listed; fields whose position was never recorded are named without an

digitizer.7.name: Pen report (ELAN9008 04F3:4631)
digitizer.7.source: findings/006 section 3; usage table STATIC (report descriptor fixture)
digitizer.7.other_fields: In Range, Tip/Barrel/Invert/Eraser/Secondary bits, X, Y, Tip Pressure 0-4096, Battery Strength 0-255, X/Y Tilt, Azimuth, Scan Time - usages and ranges known from the descriptor, byte positions not recorded per-field; parse fixtures/px13-hn7306/elan9008-04f3-4631.rdesc

digitizer.34.name: Pen-presence telemetry (0xFF0F/0x50)
digitizer.34.other_fields: first field repeats the transducer serial (offset not recorded); the remaining words read zero

fields.name: seamless_pair_capable
fields.note: host writes 01 (capable); read back 01 from this digitizer

digitizer.0x56.name: Seamless pairing - Host Bluetooth Report (0xFFF4)
digitizer.0x56.direction: set-only (GET returns no data, Windows and Linux)

digitizer.0x6e.name: Seamless pairing - Device Bluetooth Report / announcement (0xFFF4)

fields.name: device_bluetooth_address
fields.note: never connect to this address; it is not the bonding identity

fields.name: flags

bit meanings.0x02: host pairing exists (for the address last set via 0x56)

observed: 0x01 = random, no pairing with this host

digitizer.0x6f.name: Seamless pairing - Pairing Key Report (0xFFF4)
digitizer.0x6f.source: reference implementation tools/capture/linux/06-seamless-pairing.py (the frame the pen accepts and answers)

fields.name: host_pairing_key
fields.note: temporary key; the Linux path passes zeros (passkey 0 makes the key unused) - Windows passes a random 16 bytes

digitizer.0x6f.note: the Microsoft guide's field list is address+type+16-byte key; this is the byte packing observed working on this hardware (24 bytes with the report id)

ble.0x40.name: Pen identity (feature 0x40; on Linux read the plain characteristic 0x2A4D - no Report Reference descriptors exist)
ble.0x40.other_fields: zero padding to the report length
ble.0x40.transport_quirk: the 0x2A4D characteristic (Bluetooth SIG HID Report) carries the same ten bytes, WITHOUT a report-id byte, serial first

ble.0x41.output.name: Haptic playback (output 0x41)
ble.0x41.output.source: findings/006 section 4, findings/009; five HID usages 0x0E:0x21/0x23/0x24/0x25/0x28

fields.name: repeat_count
fields.note: extra plays after the first; every felt send uses 01

fields.name: intensity
fields.note: 0xFF full; user slider maps round(pct*255/100); 0x40 felt clearly weaker

values.1: None - the real stop AND disarm on this firmware
values.3+: index into the feature 0x42 waveform list

ble.0x41.feature.name: Current playback state (feature 0x41, read)
ble.0x41.feature.other_fields: readback at rest: repeat 0, intensity FF, auto-trigger 1, retrigger 0 - per-field byte positions not recorded

ble.0x42.name: Haptic capabilities (feature 0x42, read)
ble.0x42.other_fields: blob layout inside the feature report not published; these are the decoded values

ble.0x43.name: Top-button gestures (input 0x43, notified on handle 0x0019)
ble.0x43.source: findings/006 section 5 (payload identified 2026-10-21 from the pen's hidraw node)

fields.name: keycode
fields.note: one press+release pair per gesture: the PEN classifies the gesture

fields.name: keycodes_4_to_7
fields.note: unused; release frame is all zeroes

ble.battery.name: Battery percentage (Battery service, notification on ATT handle 0x0015)
